87 transparent retail-style CCG structure deck box composites.

Created with the built-in Image Generation tool, based on the user-provided retail packaging references and the corrected A.I.P layout. Each family uses individually selected local card artwork. The artwork-selection.json file records those choices. Vanquish Soul uses local original Razen artwork because the custom Brawl card image is missing.

The blue CCG corner logo was removed; the previous red CUSTOM EDITION badge is restored. Front and spine titles use the same family name, with separate spine logo and title positions.
